cohort: Fifty women, primarily in the perimenopausal age group (41-50 years) and often with dysfunctional uterine bleeding, were recruited from a tertiary care teaching institution to assess their satisfaction with LNG-IUS Mirena.
finding: After 6 months of follow-up, 44% of patients reported high satisfaction and 34% were satisfied with LNG-IUS Mirena, indicating it is a suitable alternative to hysterectomy for dysfunctional uterine bleeding.
mod_finding: Among patients with dysfunctional uterine bleeding, 58% had previous full-term vaginal deliveries, followed by 30% with previous caesarean sections.
